name: Liquid-hydrogen screen-channel LAD outflow test at 20.3 K
plain_name: Liquid-hydrogen screen-channel LAD outflow test at 20.3 K
description: Reproduce the documented 20.3 K fluid condition for NASA SMiRF inverted 1-g vertical screen-channel LAD outflow. This requires an actual propellant acquisition/outflow apparatus.

sources.citation: Hartwig et al., Screen Channel Liquid Acquisition Device Outflow Tests in Liquid Hydrogen

reported_conditions.as_printed: fixed fluid saturation temperatures of 20.3, 21.4, 22.9, and 24.2K

requirements.rationale: Section 6.1 reports fixed fluid saturation temperatures including 20.3 K; cold reach alone cannot satisfy this operating-point requirement.
The experiment requires screen-channel LAD outflow plumbing and controlled flow.

missing_information: Tank pressure, mass-flow setpoint, screen bubble-point and detailed LAD geometry must match the selected row of Table 3. This profile does not infer a continuous controllable temperature interval or orbital microgravity behavior.
confirmation_note: Curated bounded procedure from the cited source. User must confirm applicability before an interactive verification. Passing encoded checks does not establish unmodeled performance.
verification_scope: Temperature plus the named indispensable measurement/handling functions; no extrapolation of undocumented performance, pressure, calibration, cleanliness or full facility safety.
